My Ref. No.: 4-3/23/2023/WR/87. Divisional Secretary's Ref. No.: WEG/LAN/L9/ACQ/72.

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Proviso (a) to Section 38 of Land acquisition Act (Chapter 460), I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, do hereby direct the Acquiring Oﬃ cer or any other oﬃ cer authorized by him referred to in Column I of the Schedule to take immediate possession of the land speciﬁ ed in the corresponding entry in Column II of that Schedule.
K. D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.
Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”,No.1200/06, Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.19th March, 2025.
